SHOP POLICIES

The small print.

How ordering, delivery, returns and your details work at Teasire.

Delivery

We deliver within Malaysia by tracked courier and send you the tracking number on WhatsApp.

  • Signature teas are packed within 1–2 working days of payment. Custom blends are blended to order and packed within 3–5 working days.
  • After dispatch, delivery takes 2–4 working days in Peninsular Malaysia and 4–7 working days to Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan.
Peninsular MalaysiaRM8.00
SabahRM15.00
SarawakRM15.00
LabuanRM15.00
Orders above RM150Free

Returns & refunds

  • Damaged, wrong or missing items: message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with a photo of the parcel and items. We’ll send a replacement or refund you in full, including delivery.
  • Change of mind: tea is a food product, so we can’t take back opened packs. Unopened signature teas can be returned within 7 days of delivery. You pay the return postage, and we refund the tea once it arrives.
  • Custom blends are made just for you, so they can’t be returned for a change of mind.
  • Refunds are paid by bank transfer or DuitNow within 7 working days of approval. Online payments can also be refunded to the original payment method.

Cancellations

  • Before you pay, there’s nothing to cancel: just let us know.
  • After you pay, you can cancel for a full refund until your order is packed. Custom blends can’t be cancelled once blending has started.
  • Once your order has been sent, our returns policy applies.

Terms of sale

  • Prices are in Malaysian Ringgit (RM), per pack of 10 individually packed teabags. Delivery for your location is added in your bag unless your order is above RM150.
  • You order by sending your bag to us on WhatsApp and paying the total shown. We confirm your order once we have checked your payment. If anything is unavailable, we refund it in full.
  • We accept DuitNow QR, including Touch ’n Go eWallet. Please pay the exact total shown in your order.
  • You can also pay online by FPX online banking, credit or debit card or eWallet through Billplz. Your order is confirmed as soon as Billplz confirms your payment.
  • Our teas are made from natural botanicals, so colour and flavour can vary slightly between batches. If an ingredient is unavailable, we’ll offer a substitute or a refund for that item.
  • Green, black and oolong teas contain caffeine. Our teas are not medicines. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have allergies, check the ingredients and ask your doctor if unsure.
  • We may update these policies. The version on this page when you order applies to your order.

Privacy

  • When you send an order, we receive what is in your WhatsApp message: your name, email, delivery details, notes and WhatsApp number. We use them only to confirm, deliver and support your order.
  • If you pay online, your order, name, email, phone number and delivery address are sent to us and to Billplz, our payment provider, to take your payment. Card and bank details are entered only on Billplz’s page; we never see them.
  • Your bag and saved blends are stored in your own browser. They aren’t sent to us unless you include them in a message.
  • We share your name, phone number and address only with our courier, to deliver your order. We never sell your details.
  • We keep order records only as long as needed for your order and our accounts.
  • This site doesn’t use tracking or advertising cookies. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, and WhatsApp messages are covered by WhatsApp’s own privacy policy.
  • To see, correct or delete your details, message us on WhatsApp.

Contact

Message us on WhatsApp using the button at the bottom of any page.
